name: Community Food Connection
summary: Find groceries and meals at NYC food pantries and community kitchens.

details.action: Open the NYC Food Help Finder and enter your ZIP code to find nearby food locations. Confirm hours before visiting, or call 311.
details.limitations: Availability and hours vary by location. This is a resource referral, not a benefit approval.

name: SNAP
summary: Monthly grocery assistance through an EBT card.

details.action: Open the official SNAP guide and start an application through ACCESS HRA; an interview is part of the process.
details.limitations: This MVP does not implement SNAP financial, deduction, work, student, or immigration rules. HRA must assess your application.

name: Homebase
summary: Housing support for New Yorkers at risk of entering shelter.

details.action: Call 311 to locate your Homebase office and arrange an appointment.
documents: Rent demand or court papers, if any
details.limitations: An office reviews your circumstances. Missing documents do not prevent an initial assessment.

name: One Shot Deal
summary: Emergency financial assistance assessed individually by HRA.

details.action: Read the official emergency assistance guide and request a case review through ACCESS HRA.
details.limitations: Eligibility is case by case. Savings, emergency circumstances, future affordability and other factors matter. Some or all assistance may need to be repaid.

name: Cash Assistance
summary: Ongoing cash support for households in need.

details.action: Review the Cash Assistance guide and apply through ACCESS HRA; follow the interview instructions on your confirmation.
details.limitations: HRA reviews income, household composition, resources and other requirements. This MVP cannot calculate eligibility or payment amounts.

name: Unemployment Insurance
summary: New York State income support after qualifying job loss.

details.action: Read the NY Department of Labor filing guidance and file promptly if you believe you may qualify.
details.limitations: DOL determines eligibility. Wage history, separation reason, work search, hours and earnings require review. This MVP only checks a few initial indicators.

name: Fair Fares NYC
summary: Reduced transit fares for qualifying NYC residents.

details.action: Check the current Fair Fares requirements on the official page and apply through ACCESS HRA.
details.limitations: Preliminary screening uses the cited page's age and annual household income table. Other fare benefits and agency verification are not evaluated.
